curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What family secret will an orphanage manager discover after being sent from India to Copenhagen?
curatedMovie.description: An Indian orphanage manager travels to Copenhagen and discovers a family secret that alters his life.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, thoughtful drama paced with measured deliberation; demanding, emotionally resonant, and best experienced solo.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director Susanne Bier delivers an emotionally heavy drama grounded in nuanced performances, balancing quiet moral dilemmas with deep cross-continental resonance.
